description: Fetch one SWSD problem (ITIL problem record) by id or number. Returns the full problem detail as returned by SWSD (passthrough). Use swsd_list_problems first if you only have a name or filter — IDs are not guessable. Pass detail_level: "long" to include comments, audits, tasks, and time_tracks in one call.

detail_level.description: Use "long" for inline comments/audits/tasks/time_tracks. Default "short" is faster and cheaper.

id.description: SWSD problem reference. Accepts either the internal id (>=7 digits) or the human-facing number (<=6 digits). The handler auto-detects via digit count.

name: swsd_get_problem
